title: Anthony Hopkins finds Feifer's annotated copy of The Girl from Petrovka

tellings.quote: Heading for home, he chanced upon a book on a bench at the Lester Square tube station.

plain: The actor Anthony Hopkins, the story goes, was cast in a film of the novel The Girl from Petrovka, couldn't find a copy, and then found one left on a bench at Leicester Square tube station in London, which turned out to be the author George Feifer's own copy with his notes in it. Michael Shermer, a well-known skeptic, tells this to Michels without naming a source: "Heading for home, he chanced upon a book on a bench at the Lester Square tube station." Shermer offers it as an example of a coincidence so striking it feels meaningful.
